27. Commit Graphs, Parents and
References

SIMPLE ENGLISH
Git commits form a directed acyclic graph through parent links. Refs name commits; HEAD~1
selects the first parent, and HEAD^2 selects a merge commit's second parent.
සිංහJලෙන් Commits වල parent links තිJයනවා. Merge commit එකකට parents Jදකකේ තිබිය හැකියි.

Why is Git history a graph rather than a list? Branches diverge and merges have multiple parents.
